 Marco Pierre White becomes grandfather for fourth time
 Marco Pierre White's son Luciano has become a father to a baby girl with his fashion designer fiancee,' Stephanie Beard
 By 
 Web Desk 
 | 
 Published November 14, 2026 
 It has been a special year for the couple, who got engaged in January and announced that they were expecting their first child in July Marco Pierre White's son Luciano has become a father to a baby girl with his fashion designer fiancee,' Stephanie Beard. 
 Taking to Instagram account, the chef, 34 shared gorgeous pictures of their newborn daughter, including a black-and white-image of the trio lying together on a hospital bed.
 Other sweet snaps showed Luciano and Stephanie cradling their little bundle of joy as they smiled for the camera.
 Revealing his daughter's sweet name, he penned: ‘Our little princess! Paloma BLU Pierre White.'
 READ MORE:  Gordon Ramsay reveals ‘most important thing in life' 
 Paloma is now Marco's fourth grandchild. 
 The legendary chef, 64, became a grandfather for the first time in 2019 when his second son, Marco Pierre White Jr, welcomed a daughter named Arabella Rosa.
 It has been a special year for the couple, who got engaged in January and announced that they were expecting their first child in July.
